blocks.content: This course is the fourth and final course in our React App Development skill track, and the third course that deals with React:

rows: Prelude to React that teaches you asynchronous code
Introduces various hooks (JavaScript functions) that you can attach to React components
Teaches you to add URLs to your app

blocks.content: And now, this React Beyond Basics course will teach you how to separate your app into different pages with different URLs.
Let's walk down memory lane and observe the Daily Journal App we created in the previous course. That'll give you some context as to why routing is important.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
